title: Ogummaa Yeroo Hin Qabne Kan Kennu
intro: Namni kabajamaa, hubannoo gadi fagoo fi gorsa ogummaa qabuun kan beekamu, yeroo tokko gorsa dhaloota caalu kenna ture. Jechoonni isaanii, macaafa qulqulluu keessatti galmaa’an, namoota dhuunfaa gara galateeffannaa, obsaa fi amala qajeelummaatti qajeelcha.
clues: Raajii osoo hin taane ogummaan eebbifame.
Mucaa koo cubbuu guddaa irratti gorseera: Rabbiin waliin shariika gochuu.
Ulfaatina hojii, gatii sanyii sanaaficaa illee, akkamitti Rabbiin akka baasu barsiiseera.
Qabsoo mucaa guddisuun godhamu beekamtii kennuudhaan Rabbii fi warra ofii galateeffachuu cimsee ibseera.
Gorsi ani kenne kadhannaa hundeessuun, gaarii ajajuu, hamaa dhorkuu fi wanta nama mudatu obsaan dandamachuu kan dabalatu ture.
Qur’aana keessatti boqonnaan tokko maqaa kootiin kan moggaafame yoo ta’u, barsiisa koo fi barumsa ani qooddadhe of keessaa qaba.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
